description: This class extends JTextField to allow setting an explicit preferred width for the component in a GUI.

classes.name: JTextFieldWithWidth
classes.description: A custom JTextField that allows specifying a fixed preferred width.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth(int width)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the text field with an empty string and specified width.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes with empty text and width 200.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth(String text)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes with specified text and default width of 200.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth(String text, int width)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes with specified text and width.

methods.name: getPreferredSize()
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the preferred width to the specified value.
